decision_card.headline: Directional only; resolve QC or stability risks before budget-level decisions.
policy_rules: RED: QC gate FAIL, or QC gate missing while diagnostics include FAIL runs.
YELLOW: QC gate REVIEW/missing, diagnostics beyond green limits, or stable-baseline sensitivity >= 15.0%.
GREEN: QC gate PASS, diagnostics within limits (FAIL <= 0, REVIEW <= 5), and stable-baseline sensitivity < 15.0%.
Prior guardrail: YELLOW if any row has P(ROI<0) > 0.20.
PASS coverage gate: GREEN requires PASS coverage >= 60.0%.
Robustness band gate: GREEN requires robustness band HIGH.
triggered_rules: YELLOW rule: QC gate result is REVIEW.
YELLOW rule: diagnostics REVIEW runs (32) exceed green limit (5).
YELLOW rule: PASS coverage 0.0% (0/32, scope=pass_only) is below green minimum 60.0%.
reasons: Broad exploration diagnostics: PASS 0.0%, REVIEW 32, FAIL 0.
QC gate window: 32 run(s), PASS 0, REVIEW 32, FAIL 0.
Robustness score: 55.12/100 (Medium), weighting=spend, runs=27, tag=full_grid_run_846bf5c06235. Target-subset score=55.12/100.
Percent-change safeguard: 5/5 channel-prior pair(s) had unstable baseline ROI; those pairs are ranked by |Delta ROI| instead of % change.
Prior guardrail: 0 run(s), 0/256 row(s) exceed threshold P(ROI<0)>0.20 (0.0%), max P(ROI<0)=0.00.
Most sensitive channel-prior pair under safeguard: tiktok (LogNormal), max |Delta ROI|=1.1554 (baseline unstable for % metric).
actions: Keep conclusions directional; avoid hard budget shifts from single-run snapshots.
Treat the largest prior-driven movers as audit findings, not queued experiments.
Use Sensitivity for target-level robustness context when robustness output is available.

score_meta.methodology_note: This robustness score is a project-defined prior sensitivity heuristic, not an official Meridian metric. It measures how stable each channel's posterior ROI/contribution estimates are under prior perturbations, conditional on the selected structural profile.
